plans.label: balanced

CSE 101 fulfills Design and Analysis of Algorithms; MATH 180B and MATH 158 continue the applied math chain; CAT 1 and CAT 2 progress the writing sequence; ANTH 5 and ANTH 1 satisfy natural sciences and social analysis. plans.label: lightest

Applied mathematics elective MATH 170B and Social Analysis ANTH 1 complete college requirements early. Subsequent quarters continue the major chain with CSE 107 and MATH 180B, then CSE 110 and MATH 184, accumulating the computational and general CS electives needed for graduation.
